tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the org's connected providers and status.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Cross-provider rollup: balance, burn rate, days-to-zero, month-to-date spend, projection, rate-limit headroom. Per provider, spend_basis says where month-to-date spend comes from: 'reported' (provider usage or itemized events) or 'observed_since_connected' (summed balance drops since observed_since,

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Full metrics + rate-limit snapshots for one connection id. Includes spend_basis ('reported' | 'observed_since_connected'), observed_since and balance_scope ('account' | 'key' | 'unknown').

tools.name: get_rate_limit_status
tools.description: Latest rate-limit headroom and error rate across the org's providers.

tools.name: get_advisories
tools.description: All current advisories (top-up, upgrade, near-limit, spend-spike) across providers.

tools.name: get_cost_accuracy
tools.description: Cost-accuracy state per provider: whether itemized costs are exact, estimated, or unreconciled, with the drift % between Argus's itemized total and the provider's own reported spend. 'unreconciled' means no provider anchor has been compared yet; where one exists (OpenRouter) it covers only calls sen

tools.name: get_request_costs
tools.description: Recent itemized per-request costs for a provider (model, tokens, cost in USD, provenance). Args: provider (string), limit (number, default 25, max 100).

tools.name: list_available_providers
tools.description: Providers that can be connected with an API key (poll plane). Anything else can still be tracked by sending telemetry — see https://argus.town/docs/ingest.

tools.name: create_connect_link
tools.description: Hand a provider credential to Argus without it passing through you: returns a single-use URL (valid 1 hour) where your operator pastes the key. Show the URL to your operator, then poll get_connect_link for the connection id. Prefer this over connect_provider whenever you don't already hold the secre

tools.name: get_connect_link
tools.description: Status of a connect link: pending, submitting (the human is mid-submit), done (with connection_id), expired, or locked after repeated bad credentials.

tools.name: connect_provider
tools.description: Connect a provider to THIS project with a credential. Validates the credential against the provider before storing it (encrypted), then queues the initial sync. tools.name: sync_connection
tools.description: Queue an immediate balance/usage/plan refresh for one connection. Args: connection_id.
